facts.title: blue cheese and red potato tart
ingredients: 1 Savory Tart Shell, below, or recipe of your choice, in a 9-inch tart pan and ready to fill
1 pound small red potatoes, scrubbed and cut into 1/4-inch slices
1 tablespoons finely chopped herb or herbs of your choice, such as a mixture of thyme and rosemary
facts.author: Deb Perelman
